title: Zesty Dense Slovakian Pork Bake
description: A hearty Slovakian dish featuring pork, coriander seeds, and a hint of wine, baked to perfection on a slate tile. This energizing meal is suitable for a Buddhist temple gathering.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees Fahrenheit.
Grind the coriander seeds and caraway seeds in a spice grinder until coarsely ground.
Season the pork shoulder with salt, black pepper, and the ground coriander and caraway seeds.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat and sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides.
Transfer the pork to a slate tile and arrange the sliced potatoes around it.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the red wine to the skillet and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Pour the wine and onion mixture over the pork and potatoes on the slate tile.
Bake the pork and potatoes in the preheated oven for 2 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender and the potatoes are golden brown.
